direct.note: direct.py contract. Keys: url, path/installer_path, version, version_regex, file_name, verify_ssl(default True), sha256, size.
rules: url XOR path required, else ValueError "direct provider requires 'url' or 'path'"
version_regex extracts group(1) from URL when version absent
file_name fallback chain: config file_name > URL last segment > "browser-installer.exe"

script.note: script.py contract. Keys: command (list or str), plus passthrough fields the script prints.
rules: runs command, decodes stdout, parses JSON
parse_json_output: empty stdout => RuntimeError "Script provider returned empty stdout."
full-text JSON parse first; on failure scan lines REVERSED, first line that starts { and ends } => parse
all fail => RuntimeError "Script provider stdout must contain a JSON object."
command str => shlex.split (POSIX rules); list => as-is
